DOCUMENT doc-D823NJ — Review criteria memorandum
The dossier defines claim ZCEQZC as "combined readiness review". Its complete eligibility rule is this: support requires and is supplied by the condition that items P8U7YD and E6TEV7 are all usable together. Treat the listed routes as exhaustive. Claim 6HT6NK records "reserve sensor review". Under the agreed review policy, it is supported if and only if item DWLFKG is usable. These are the only sufficient routes. The review heading "gust-recording display review" has identifier 57VRSA. It may be retained on the following exhaustive basis: support requires and is supplied by the condition that items DZESTG and 8GFVHB are all usable together. For claim E6TEV7, "original-record review", the listed warrant is complete: it is supported if and only if items 7Q8SR6 and G5B7VF are all usable together. No other route is authorised. The dossier defines claim P8U7YD as "main sensor review". Its complete eligibility rule is this: any one of the following complete routes is sufficient: items DZESTG and 8GFVHB are all usable together; alternatively, items F9BBQY and G5B7VF are all usable together. Treat the listed routes as exhaustive. Claim XZR4GE records "packing-table rota review". Under the agreed review policy, it is supported if and only if item QSRTUU is usable. These are the only sufficient routes.

DOCUMENT doc-LUVMZT — Authorisation checklist
Decision QLU2G6, "retain the packing-table rota plan", is supported exactly when claim XZR4GE is supported. There are no additional prerequisites. To support decision EDKPYP ("approve the reserve sensor work"), the complete requirement is that claim 6HT6NK is supported; satisfying that requirement is also sufficient. Decision PZX42H, "approve the paired sensor session", is supported exactly when claim E6TEV7 is supported. There are no additional prerequisites. To support decision 7G8S6R ("approve the gust-recording display"), the complete requirement is that claim 57VRSA is supported; satisfying that requirement is also sufficient. Decision ZCMA87, "approve the expanded sensor session", is supported exactly when claims P8U7YD and 57VRSA are all supported. There are no additional prerequisites. To support decision BXFSGA ("approve the main sensor pilot"), the complete requirement is that claim ZCEQZC is supported; satisfying that requirement is also sufficient.

DOCUMENT doc-DRYSTZ — Review scope memorandum
This fictional field sensor kit packet defines a closed review. Evidence records and claims have separate identifiers; a decision identifier labels an action whose support is being assessed, not an instruction to carry it out. A locally unavailable record cannot be used. A copy also requires all its listed parents and contributes no new observation. Use only the exhaustive routes in this packet. Missing support does not establish falsity. Apply any later eligibility notice to the named record versions only. In the criteria, an evidence item is usable under the record rules; a claim used as an item is usable exactly when that claim is supported.

DOCUMENT doc-FR98T8 — Field sensor kit source register
This register describes initial local availability before any later eligibility notice. Record 8GFVHB is the cable-connector inspection; it is an original observation record, available from the start. Record QSRTUU is the packing-table rota check; it is an original observation record, available from the start. Record GEVVCG, the workshop digest, version D1, is locally available at the start but is a copy drawn only from record 7Q8SR6; every named parent is required for its use. Record DZESTG, the schedule excerpt copied from digest D1, is locally available at the start but is a copy drawn only from record GEVVCG; every named parent is required for its use. Record F9BBQY, the parallel summary, version S1, is locally available at the start but is a copy drawn only from record 7Q8SR6; every named parent is required for its use. Record G5B7VF is the Station Willow trace; it is an original observation record, available from the start. Record 7Q8SR6 is the Station Juniper trace, revision J1; it is an original observation record, available from the start. Record DWLFKG is the reserve case-label check awaiting release; it is an original observation record, not available at the start and never released by this packet.

DECISIONS TO EVALUATE
QLU2G6: Is the decision to retain the packing-table rota plan currently supported under this packet?
EDKPYP: Is the decision to approve the reserve sensor work currently supported under this packet?
PZX42H: Is the decision to approve the paired sensor session currently supported under this packet?
7G8S6R: Is the decision to approve the gust-recording display currently supported under this packet?
ZCMA87: Is the decision to approve the expanded sensor session currently supported under this packet?
BXFSGA: Is the decision to approve the main sensor pilot currently supported under this packet?

AUTHORITATIVE CURRENT-ELIGIBILITY SNAPSHOT
The following records are locally ineligible: GEVVCG. This overrides earlier local-eligibility statements for these exact IDs only. All other local eligibility and all support rules remain as in the packet. Copies still depend on their parents. This removes warrants, not the truth of propositions.

Return the current decision-support map.
